name: Publish work as a private link
tagline: Turns anything your bot makes into a live page on a private link
description: A report, a plan or a one-pager becomes a URL you can send, with no account needed at the other end. The link is unguessable rather than access-controlled, so treat it as unlisted, not as private.
author: stevy_smith
notes: Listed on grokbot.dev. Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
